description: This file implements Bluetooth GATT Server Socket functionality, including serialization/deserialization of attributes, handling Bluetooth security settings, and processing Bluetooth GATT commands in a socket-based communication context.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth GATT attribute with deserialization logic.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth GATT server socket communication, including security configurations and command processing.

classes.name: GATTSocket::Command
classes.description: Represents and processes Bluetooth GATT commands received over the socket.

methods.name: Attribute::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes attribute data from a byte stream, handling variable length fields and setting internal state accordingly.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Command::Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream to process Bluetooth GATT commands, handling various operation responses and errors.

methods.name: GATTSocket::Security
methods.description: Configures Bluetooth security level and sets socket options accordingly.

methods.name: GATTSocket::StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes and retrieves connection info when socket becomes open.
